title: Pixel Dungeon
tagline: A five-room turn-based dungeon: grab the coins, find the way out, and watch what follows you.
readinessNote: Every room is a 12×9 text grid in one JSON list (Pages/Play): walls, floor, coins, creatures, start and exit are characters. Add a room by adding an entry; no code. New tile kinds need a state in Game/Cell and a check in Game/Move.
buildYourOwn: Rooms, tile looks, the number of hearts; new tile kinds with a little graph work.
